catatan: Lanjutan pilihan PRESS THE ALARM. Fiksi orisinal, bahasa Inggris USA.

baris.arah: (bored tired middle-aged hotel clerk answering a call, flat and calm)

baris.text: I'm stuck on floor thirteen! Someone's holding the door!
baris.arah: (panicked shouting, desperate and fast, out of breath)

baris.text: Sir... this hotel doesn't have a floor thirteen.
baris.arah: (confused and slow, long pause, puzzled and a little uneasy)

baris.text: Then who are you talking to?
baris.arah: (creepy calm girl whisper, slow, cold and smiling, sinister)
(screaming in terror, falling, hysterical and frantic)
(reading slowly in a scared whisper, confused)

baris.text: Room thirteen thirteen is waiting for you.
baris.arah: (creepy sweet girl voice, slow, singsong and cold, sinister)
(scared whisper with a hint of hope, breathing fast)

noob.desain: (young American teenage boy gamer, about seventeen, casual natural voice, relaxed and a little sarcastic)
noob.ref_teks: Man, this hotel is so quiet tonight. Nobody is in the lobby, and my room is all the way at the top.

lily.desain: (young American girl, about fourteen, soft sweet voice, a little breathy)
lily.ref_teks: I lost my friends somewhere in this hotel, and now I can't remember which floor my room is on.

desk.desain: (middle-aged American man, tired hotel night clerk, deep calm voice, polite)
desk.ref_teks: Good evening, this is the front desk. How can I help you tonight? Is everything alright with your room?
